--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -6.0000f);
  glRotatef(35.2500f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(45.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---

  // gl-repl logo
  // An open cube with distinct front and back colors.
  // Normals are defined per-face for crisp, flat-lit lighting.
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0, 0, 0, 0});

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glColor3f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98);
  glColorMaterial(GL_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    // +Y face
    glColor3f(0.95, 0.25, 1);
    glNormal3f(0, 1, 0);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, -1);
    // -Y face
    glNormal3f(0, -1, 0);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, 1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, 1);
    // +Z face
    glColor3f(0.25, 0.675, 1);
    glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, 1);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, 1);
    // -Z face
    glNormal3f(0, 0, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, -1);
  glEnd();
